summary: Verified Welcome page desktop features section responsiveness fix. The floating chrome (progress rail + quick navigator) is now correctly hidden at desktop widths below 1680px (tested 1440, 1479, 1600), and only appears at ultra-wide widths (1728+). The capability matrix maintains comfortable width (1114-1160px) with 3-column grid layout and ~359px card widths. No horizontal overflow detected at any viewport. Mobile/tablet responsiveness preserved.
critical_code_review_comments: The fix correctly raises the floating chrome visibility threshold to 1680px (canShowFloatingWelcomeChrome = viewportChromeWidth >= 1680)
The capability matrix uses CSS grid with 3-column layout at desktop widths, providing ~359px card widths which is comfortable
The command center shell has a max-width constraint that prevents it from becoming too wide while still using available space efficiently
